overviews.de: Als ein junger Erbe den Thron besteigt, verbindet er seine königliche Herkunft mit einem ausgeprägten Hang zur Rebellion. Unter dem Namen Raja Saab übernimmt er die Führung und beginnt, bestehende Strukturen aufzubrechen, indem er eigene Regeln etabliert und neue Wege einschlägt.
overviews.ru: За Гангаммой, страдающей болезнью Альцгеймера, ухаживает ее внук РаджаСааб. Она почти все забывает, но цепляется за воспоминания о своем муже Канакараджу, экзорцисте, который, как считается, живет в изгнании. Поиски деда приводят РаджаСааба в Хайдарабад, где он влюбляется в набожную монахиню Бесси, а другая женщина, внучка вора, по имени Бхайрави, предлагает помощь в поисках Канакараджу. В конце концов поиски приводят группу в печально известный особняк с привидениями. Они обнаруживают, что Канакараджу - не жертва, а виновник всех их бед...
overviews.fr: Un jeune héritier embrasse à la fois son héritage royal et son esprit rebelle tandis qu'il accède au pouvoir, établissant des règles sans précédent durant son règne en tant que Raja Saab.

items.title: Biker
items.overview: A seasoned motocross rider returns to the grueling sport he once abandoned, confronting fierce competition and a father who might push him to the brink.

overviews.pt: Um piloto de motocross experiente volta ao esporte que abandonou, encarando uma forte concorrência e um pai disposto a levá-lo ao extremo.
overviews.pl: Doświadczony motocrossowiec wraca do wyczerpującego sportu, który kiedyś porzucił, mierząc się z silną konkurencją i ojcem, który doprowadza go na skraj wytrzymałości.
overviews.tr: Deneyimli bir motokrosçu, bıraktığı bu zorlu spora geri dönerken çetin bir rekabet ve sınırlarını zorlayan babasıyla yüzleşir.

items.title: Pushpa 2 - The Rule
items.overview: As his smuggling empire grows, a brazen Pushpa longs for power and respect on his vengeful journey, while facing old rivals and new.

overviews.de: Pushpa und Bhanwar Singh setzen ihre Rivalität in diesem epischen Abschluss des zweiteiligen Action-Dramas fort.
overviews.fr: Pushpa Raj est devenu une figure puissante et redoutée dans le commerce illégal de bois de santal rouge. Après avoir affronté des ennemis dans le premier volet, ce second chapitre met en lumière sa montée en puissance et sa rivalité intense avec l’officier de police Bhanwar Singh.
overviews.ru: Это вторая часть серии фильмов «Пушпа» и продолжение фильма 2021 года «Пушпа: Восхождение». Столкновение продолжается: Пушпа и Бханвар Сингх продолжают свое соперничество в этом эпическом завершении двухсерийной боевика.
overviews.es: Pushpa y Bhanwar Singh continúan su rivalidad en esta épica conclusión de la serie de dos partes.
overviews.ko: 그의 밀수 제국이 확장됨에 따라, 대담한 푸슈파는 복수의 여정에서 권력과 존경을 갈망하며, 옛 라이벌들과 새로운 적들을 마주하게 된다.
overviews.pt: À medida que seu império de contrabando cresce, o audacioso Pushpa anseia por poder e respeito em sua jornada vingativa, enquanto enfrenta antigos rivais e novos.

items.title: Raja Cheyyi Vesthe
items.overview: An aspiring film director narrates a breath-taking story to his girlfriend in a coffee shop. An unknown message knocks the door the next day, asking him to write a love story. He sends his own love story, which impresses the stranger, but he asks for an action ending for killing a brutal villain. Hero sends a thrilling plot. This time the stranger sends a parcel with a gun to kill the real life brutal villain implying the same plot this time. Hero ends up knowing the cruel intentions of the villain and tries to escape from this trap. But he receives a message showing his girlfriend meeting a planned accident. That states a warning that there is no going back. Can a common man really attempt to kill a brutal villain for his loved ones? Who is the unknown stranger behind this? How will hero unfold the mysterious murder plan?

items.title: Lucky Baskhar
items.overview: A cash-strapped bank cashier embarks on a risky investment scheme and soon gets drawn into the murky world of money laundering.

overviews.de: Obgleich Baskhar ein gewöhnlicher Mann ist, verbirgt sich hinter seiner Person dennoch eine fesselnde Reise über seine großen Triumphe.
overviews.pt: Um caixa de banco sem dinheiro embarca em um esquema de investimento arriscado e logo é atraído para o mundo obscuro da lavagem de dinheiro.
overviews.it: Un cassiere di banca a corto di soldi si imbarca in un rischioso piano di investimento e ben presto si ritrova coinvolto nel torbido mondo del riciclaggio di denaro.
overviews.ru: Бедный кассир, работающий в банке, ввязывается в рискованную инвестиционную схему и вскоре оказывается втянутым в мрачный мир отмывания денег.
overviews.tr: Monoton hayatından sıkılıp maceraya atılmak isteyen orta sınıf bir banka memuru, beklenmedik bir şekilde zengin olunca hiç hesaba katmadığı durumlarla karşılaşır.

items.title: Pushpa: The Rise
items.overview: As Pushpa, a labourer, rises in the world of red sandalwood smuggling, he ends up making many enemies. However, violence ensues when the police try to topple his illegal business.

overviews.ru: Пушпа - грузчик, который пробивает себе путь в мире контрабанды красного сандалового дерева. По пути он не стесняется нажить себе одного-двух врагов...
overviews.fr: Pushpa Raj est un coolie qui grandit dans le monde de la contrebande de bois de santal rouge. En cours de route, il n'hésite pas à se faire un ennemi ou deux.
overviews.pt: Pushpa Raj é um cule que cresce no mundo do contrabando de sândalo vermelho. Ao longo do caminho, ele não hesita em fazer um ou dois inimigos.
overviews.es: Historia de Pushpa Raj, un camionero en los bosques de Seshachalam en el sur de la India, ambientada en el contexto del contrabando de sándalo rojo.
overviews.ko: 푸쉬파 라지는 붉은 샌달우드 밀수 세계에서 성공한자. 그 과정에서 그는 적 한두 명을 만드는 것을 두려워하지 않는다.
overviews.pl: Pushpa, robotnik, pnąc się w górę w świecie przemytu czerwonego drzewa sandałowego, naraża się na wielu wrogów. Jednak gdy policja próbuje zniszczyć jego nielegalny interes, dochodzi do przemocy.

items.title: The Paradise
items.overview: In 1980s Secunderabad, a marginalized tribe battles discrimination and fights for citizenship under an unexpected leader's guidance, challenging systemic oppression.

items.title: Prema Katha
items.overview: Prem, a middle class boy falls in love with his friend's fiance's female friend will his love get's succeed or ends up as tragic? is the remaining story. The story set back in a metaphoric representation of the intellect world to the real world gives us Prema Katha.

items.title: Metro Kathalu
items.overview: Revolving around Hyderabad, a city like no other, are the lives of eight people grappling with life-changing choices as their fates entwine with each other. However, they're determined to rise above the occasion and make room for life and a little more.

items.title: Vanaveera
items.overview: A descendant of the Vanara clan is pushed into conflict when a modern-day Ravana seizes his only bike for an election rally. What starts as a petty injustice soon erupts into a fierce fight for self-respect and dignity.

overviews.fr: Un descendant du clan Vanara se retrouve plongé dans un conflit lorsque Ravana des temps modernes lui confisque sa seule moto pour un meeting électoral. Ce qui commence comme une simple injustice dégénère rapidement en une lutte acharnée pour le respect de soi et la dignité.

items.title: Sita Ramam
items.overview: Afreen, a rebellious Pakistani student sets ablaze the car of an Indian in London. Angered Afreen returns to Pakistan to ask for money from her grandfather that she has to pay in a month's time as damages. However, she gets to know that he is no more and the only thing he has left for her is a letter-delivering task, written by Ram to Sita. As Afreen sets out to find Ram, there begins her journey of discovering the secret behind the 20-year-old letter.

overviews.fr: Un soldat orphelin, la vie du lieutenant Ram change après avoir reçu une lettre d'une fille nommée Sita. Il la rencontre et l'amour s'épanouit entre eux. De retour dans son camp au Cachemire, il envoie une lettre à Sita qui ne lui parviendra pas.
overviews.ru: Фильм повествует о не простой любви простого солдата индийской армии и непростой девушки в Кашмире в 1964 году.

items.title: Bommalata
items.overview: Ramu, a ragpicker, dreams of going to school and faces a corrupt system and other obstacles that prevent him from getting his fundamental right to education.

items.title: Needi Naadi Oke Katha
items.overview: Sagar  is a happy-go-lucky student who has no interest in his studies at all. Son of a teacher, he feels the pressure put on him by his father and the society both. But what happens when he fails to live up to their expectations?

items.title: Seetimaarr
items.overview: All a full-time bank employee and part-time kabaddi coach wants is to bring national relevance to the school his father built and help young kabaddi players in his village win the national championship. It might prove difficult than just coaching them though.

items.title: Family
items.overview: The plot focuses on three wives who teach a lesson to their wayward husbands who rely on their wives' property.

items.title: Raju Weds Rambai
items.overview: Raju Weds Rambai is inspired by a real story of a carefree band drummer whose love for a compounders daughter triggers a clash of ego and honour, turning their sweet village romance into an emotional journey filled with conflict, pain, and ultimately redemption.

items.title: Veera Bhoga Vasantha Rayalu
items.overview: Missing are a flight consisting of 300 VIPs, a house along with the couple that inhabit it and an orphaned girl child. Embroiled in midst of all three cases are two young boys and a man calling himself Veera Bhoga Vasantha Rayalu. What is the mystery behind either of these cases?

items.title: Dhruva
items.overview: A committed police officer is on a very dangerous mission to destroy the most corrupt person in the country, Siddharth Abhimanyu.

items.title: Prema ishq kaadhal
items.overview: Randy (Harshavardhan Rane) is a guitarist and a noble guy. He is in music field because he loves it, but not to earn money. Sarayu (Vithika Sheru) works for a charity organization and she is in awe with music and inner personality of Randy. Royal Raju (Sree Vishnu) is a street-smart guy from a village who comes to city to enjoy. He joins as an assistant director for a film and he gets attracted to a fashion designer Sameera (Ritu Varma). RJ Arjun works for a FM Radio station and he is a complete flirt. He gets attracted to a Tamil girl Santhi (Sree Mukhi) and wants to bed her. This movie is about how these unrelated love stories culminate simultaneously to tell why men follow their heart and women follow their mind.

items.title: Salaar: Part 1 - Ceasefire
items.overview: Set in the fictional dystopian city-state of Khansaar, the film follows the friendship between Deva, a tribesman, and Varadha, the prince of Khansaar. When a coup d'état is planned by his father's ministers and his relatives, Varadha enlists Deva's help to become Khansaar's undisputed ruler.

overviews.pt: Um líder de gangue tenta cumprir uma promessa feita ao seu amigo moribundo e enfrenta outras gangues criminosas.
overviews.de: Ein Bandenführer versucht ein Versprechen einzulösen, das er seinem sterbenden Freund gegeben hat. Dafür muss er es jedoch mit anderen kriminellen Banden aufnehmen.
overviews.fr: Après l'énorme succès mondial de KGF1 & KGF2. Le réalisateur Prashanth Neel nous ramène de nouveau dans son monde avec SALAAR.  Un chef de gang tente de tenir une promesse faite à son ami mourant et s'en prend aux autres gangs criminels…
overviews.ru: Главный герой, чья судьба переплетается с темной стороной подпольного мира. Оказывается перед сложным выбором, из-за обещания данного другу в детстве. Это обещание становится его священным долгом и толчком к действию. Герой, смело бросает вызов преступным группировкам. Его поступки не только нарушают хрупкое равновесие в подпольном мире, но и вызывают цепную реакцию событий, которые влияют на всю преступную среду.
overviews.ko: 치열한 권력 다툼이 벌어지고 있는 왕국. 한때 친구였지만 이제는 적이 된 두 사람의 아슬아슬한 동맹에 그 운명이 달려있다. 권력과 살육, 배신에 관한 대서사극.
overviews.it: Nella città di Khansaar, Raja Mannar progetta di nominare suo figlio, Vardharaja Mannar, suo successore, ma i ministri e i consiglieri di Raja Mannar pianificano un colpo di stato assumendo eserciti dalla Russia e dalla Serbia per attaccare e uccidere Vardha e Raja. Vardha, insieme a suo fratello e ad alcuni uomini fidati, riescono a fuggire da Khansaar. Vardha va dal suo migliore amico d'infanzia, Deva, che viene a conoscenza della sua difficile situazione e decide di renderlo l'indiscusso successore di Khansaar.

items.title: Vishnu Vinyasam
items.overview: A superstitious man confronts his deepest convictions when he discovers that the woman he has fallen for has a dark secret.

items.title: Pallakilo Pellikuturu
items.overview: A modern and independent Sasirekha meets Abhiram, a man of traditions. Forced into marriage, can they find their happily ever after?

items.title: Subhasya Seeghram
items.overview: Krishna Priya wants to fulfil her mother’s wish to get her elder sister married. What happens when she meets Radha Govind, a business tycoon who’s against marriage?

items.title: Amrutham
items.overview: Amrutham is a popular sitcom in Telugu. It was produced by Just Yellow Media. It was the longest running and most popular sitcom in Telugu.

seasonList.name: Amrutham
seasonList.overview: Amrutham (Telugu: అమృతం, lit., Amrita) is a popular sitcom in Telugu. It was produced by Just Yellow Media and is the longest running and most popular sitcom in Telugu.

items.title: Vikram On Duty
items.overview: Battling his past and personal demons, a disgraced but brilliant supercop will stop at nothing to solve crimes and earn back the uniform that defined him.

seasonList.name: Season 1
seasonList.overview: Battling his past and personal demons, a disgraced but brilliant supercop will stop at nothing to solve crimes and earn back the uniform that defined him.

items.title: Oka Chinna Family Story
items.overview: Mahesh and his mother embark on an adventurous journey filled with hilarious situations as they try to make quick money to repay a huge loan.

seasonList.name: Season 1
seasonList.overview: Mahesh is an unemployed youth who, along with his mother, must earn 25 lakh rupees to repay a loan taken by his dead father. As they struggle to make money, Mahesh realises the unsaid truth behind his dad's invaluable sacrifice.

items.title: Brahma Mudi
items.overview: The lives of Kavya and her sisters change forever as they cross paths with the Duggiraala brothers. As fate brings them closer, what's in store for them?

seasonList.name: Season 1
seasonList.overview: The lives of Kavya and her sisters change forever as they cross paths with the Duggiraala brothers. As fate brings them closer, what's in store for them?

items.title: Dead Pixels (IN)
items.overview: The journey of three young friends whose lives revolve around an online video game, with the ultimate goal of defeating a virtual villain.

seasonList.name: Season 1
seasonList.overview: When everyday living gets taken over by an online game makes more sense, it can become an obsession.

items.title: Muthyamantha Muddu
items.overview: Geetha decides to not get married for fear of her parents being neglected. Govind falls in love with her and promises to let her parents stay with them, without realising its consequences.

items.title: Sixth Sense
items.overview: A first-of-its- kind show involving the unique senses of humans and explore their thinking abilities with minutely orchestrated nuances between the host and participating celebrities. Sight, hearing, taste, smell and touch are the typically recognized human senses,

items.title: Arabia Kadali
items.overview: A fictional suspense drama series that revolves around a group of fishermen from rival villages who inadvertently trespass into international waters and find themselves imprisoned in a foreign jail.

overviews.ko: 안드라프라데시의 한 외딴 마을. 어부들은 가혹한 환경 탓에 어획기마다 생계를 위해 구자라트로 향한다. 그러나 올해는 예상치 못한 해류에 휩쓸려 국경을 넘게 되고, 파키스탄에 억울하게 구금되고 만다. 생존을 위해 몸부림치는 그들은 뜻밖에 우정을 쌓고 새로운 유대감을 형성하며, 치명적인 적들과 맞서 싸운다. 과연 그들은 살아남아 고향으로 돌아올 수 있을까?

items.title: Podarillu
items.overview: In a bid to escape her ill-fate, Maha becomes the daughter-in-law of a family with a tainted past. Can she restore their lost hope, or will it shatter hers?

items.title: Hometown
items.overview: A filmmaker revisits his hometown, remembering childhood moments that shaped him - first love, lasting friendships, his initial plane ride, and early heartaches that influenced who he became.

items.title: Super Subbu
items.overview: An unlucky teacher is assigned to teach sex ed in a hostile village. Can he balance this secret while chasing his dreams and saving his relationship?

overviews.pt: O azarado Subbu é designado para ensinar educação sexual em uma comunidade nada acolhedora. E precisa fazer o trabalho dar certo sem despertar a ira do pai conservador.
overviews.ko: 잘 풀리는 일이 없는 수부. 하필이면 성교육을 맡게 되어, 적대적인 마을에서 보수적인 아버지의 노여움을 사지 않고 어떻게든 이 일을 해내야만 한다.
overviews.tr: Talihsiz Subbu, huysuz köylülere cinsel eğitim dersi vermekle görevlendirilir. Genç adam, muhafazakâr babasının öfkesinden kaçınırken başarılı olmanın bir yolunu bulmak zorundadır.
overviews.pl: Pechowiec Subbu ma prowadzić zajęcia z edukacji seksualnej we wrogiej wiosce. Czy uda mu się osiągnąć sukces zawodowy i uniknąć gniewu konserwatywnego ojca?
overviews.fr: Subbu, un prof malchanceux dont la vie bascule lorsqu'il devient secrètement professeur d'éducation sexuelle pour adultes dans un village rural de Makhipur, conciliant les attentes strictes de son père tout en poursuivant ses rêves et sa romance.
overviews.es: Subbu, un joven con una racha de mala suerte, su vida cambia cuando se convierte secretamente en profesor de educación sexual para adultos en un pueblo rural de Makhipur, equilibrando las estrictas expectativas de su padre mientras persigue sus sueños y su romance.

seasonList.name: Season 1
seasonList.overview: When unlucky Subbu is assigned to teach sex ed in a hostile village, he must find a way to succeed while avoiding his conservative father's wrath.

items.title: Isakapatnam
items.overview: Set in the 1990s, in the ruthless port town of Isakapatnam, three forces collide—a woman driven by justice, a henchman torn by loyalty, and a common man hungry for revenge—each closing in on the empire built by the port’s most powerful man, Naidu.

overviews.pt: Ambientada em uma cidade portuária fictícia entre as décadas de 1980 e 1990, a série acompanha Naidu, um poderoso chefão do crime que constrói um império baseado no contrabando e na influência política. Quando rivais ameaçam derrubar seu domínio, o maior desafio surge dentro da própria família: sua filha Bharathi, líder de uma ONG, confronta o legado de violência do pai.
overviews.hi: बंदरगाह शहर इसाकापट्नम में, नायडू एक बाहरी व्यक्ति से उठकर उस इलाके का सबसे खौफ़नाक इंसान बन जाता है - वह बंदरगाह की राजनीति, जुर्म और बेहिसाब बेरहमी के दम पर अपना साम्राज्य खड़ा करता है। जैसे-जैसे राजनीतिक दुश्मनी, गैर-कानूनी व्यापार और बदलती वफादारियाँ एक ज़बरदस्त ड्रामा खड़ा करती हैं, नायडू अपनी जगह बनाए रखने के लिए किसी भी हद तक जाने को तैयार है। पर उसकी बेटी भारती अब उसे चुनौती देने लगती है।

items.title: Shaitan
items.overview: After attempting an attack on the Home Minister, Baali is on the run. What happens when he chooses the path of violence?...

items.title: Yeda Loyallo Indradhanasu
items.overview: On her journey to become an outstanding teacher, Amulya finds herself in the crosshairs of her corrupt boss. How will she surpass the challenges thrown her way?

items.overview: Kanakam, a brave young woman, becomes the first lady constable from her village. When she's posted to a new village where women are mysteriously disappearing, including her friend Chandrika, she begins an investigation. Despite facing resistance and shocking truths, Kanakam fights for justice and truth with courage and determination.

items.title: Rajeshwari Vilas Coffee Club
items.overview: Rajeshwari, a compassionate cook aspiring to keep her mother’s hotel thriving, challenges Rudra, an elite chef when he decides to usurp her hotel to grow his premium food business.

items.title: Rambo in Love
items.overview: An almost bankrupt entrepreneur needs funds urgently to save his business. What happens when the new investor turns out to be his ex, whom he had betrayed?

overviews.ar: تنهار شركة رامبو الناشئة حتى تدخل سوكانيا حبيبته السابقة كمستثمرة تتحكم فى مصيره. بين صراعات المكتب وندوب الماضي ومشاعر لم تطفاً، يتقاطع الكبرياء مع الحب في كوميديا رومانسية عن فرص لا تأتي إلا مرة أخرى.

items.title: Dhootha
items.overview: Journalist Sagar's life turns thrilling as he unravels dark secrets behind newspaper clippings predicting tragedies. He becomes a murder suspect, racing against time to clear his name and solve the enigma and faces dangerous twists. Suspense builds in this roller-coaster ride.

overviews.ru: В этом сверхъестественном триллере жизнь журналиста Сагара переворачивается с ног на голову, когда газеты предсказывают леденящие душу инциденты, которые разворачиваются в его жизни.
overviews.pt: A vida do jornalista Sagar fica emocionante à medida que ele desvenda segredos obscuros por trás de recortes de jornais que preveem tragédias. Ele se torna suspeito de assassinato, e corre contra o tempo para limpar seu nome e resolver o enigma, enfrentando reviravoltas perigosas. O suspense aumenta no desenrolar vertiginoso da série.
overviews.ko: 비극을 예언하는 신문 기사 조각에 숨겨진 어두운 비밀이 밝혀지면서 기자인 사가르의 삶이 흔들린다. 살인 용의자로 지목된 사가르는 누명을 벗고 수수께끼를 풀기 위해 사투를 벌이면서 위험한 반전을 맞는다. 숨 막히는 짜릿한 여정이 시작되고 긴장감이 쌓여 간다.
overviews.fr: La vie du journaliste Sagar prend un tournant haletant quand il dévoile de sombres secrets derrière des coupures de journaux prédisant des tragédies. Il devient le suspect d'un meurtre et tente alors de prouver son innocence et de résoudre l'énigme, mais il est confronté à des rebondissements dangereux. Le suspense monte et on est pris de vertige dans ce thriller oppressant.

items.title: Ennenno Janmala Bandham
items.overview: Yash loves his daughter, Khushi, but fails to express himself. Vedaswini adores the kid, which makes Yash envy her. Can Khushi bring these lonely hearts closer?

items.overview: The Guest is Telugu Indian drama thriller webseries produced by Tamada media.

items.overview: Revolves around three frustrated husbands who meet by chance and how their rants over their marital problems set off a series of crazy events.

seasonList.overview: Aaaaaand the Tigers are back. The most awaited show of the year, with more twists, love, laughter and chaos.

items.title: Bad Trip
items.overview: A shared cab ride presents a group of people the opportunity to get rich quickly. What seems like an easy job turns into a web of nightmares for the gang.

seasonList.overview: Two strangers end up sharing a cab with a hit-man-on-hire. The trip turns deliriously wacky when the hit-man gets murdered at his drop point and the two strangers decide to take on his unfinished job; to kidnap a rich woman for 3 crores.

items.title: Kotha Poradu
items.overview: This story revolves around Raju, a care-free villager who is new to the city. While his struggle seems to be never-ending, fate has a different plan in store for him.

items.title: High Priestess
items.overview: Revolves around Swathi Reddy, a tarot card reader and psychic, who deals with peculiar cases and clients that make her experience supernatural powers around her.

items.title: Vyooham
items.overview: A newly appointed police officer is assigned to a hit and run case, where a pregnant couple lost their child. What seems like a simple open and shut case, turns out to be a complicated web involving several seemingly unconnected people. To solve the case, the officer has to hunt down a serial killer, a trained Naxal, a suspended cop, and a terrorist organization, while facing his own painful past.

overviews.pt: Um policial recém-nomeado é designado para um caso de atropelamento, onde um casal grávido perdeu seu filho. O que parece ser um simples caso aberto e fechado, acaba por ser uma teia complicada envolvendo várias pessoas aparentemente desconectadas. Para resolver o caso, o policial precisa caçar um serial killer, um Naxal treinado, um policial suspenso e uma organização terrorista, enquanto enfrenta seu próprio passado doloroso.

overviews.de: In einer Welt, in der die Gerechtigkeit ins Wanken gerät, erwacht ein mächtiger Beschützer. In diesem actiongeladenen Fantasy-Spektakel erhebt sich ein Übermensch in einer verdorbenen Welt, um die Dinge wieder ins Lot zu bringen.
overviews.pt: Num mundo onde a justiça falha, a divindade guardiã Vettai Karuppu assume a forma de um advogado para combater um sistema jurídico corrupto que se aproveita dos mais vulneráveis.

Её отчаявшийся отец приезжает из Кералы в Ченнаи с золотом, чтобы оплатить операцию, но становится жертвой ограбления, а дело погружается в коррумпированную судебную систему, где бесконечно откладывается. В молитве к деревенскому божеству-хранителю семья получает неожиданный ответ — Каруппа спускается на землю в человеческом облике адвоката. Теперь тому, кто вершил правосудие на небесах, предстоит сразиться с продажной системой, циничным прокурором и безжалостными воротилами, наживающимися на чужом горе. items.title: Chintamani
items.overview: Chintamani (Tamil: சிந்தாமணி) is a 1937 Tamil-language film directed by Y. V. Rao starring M. K. Thyagaraja Bhagavathar, Serugulathur Sama and Aswathamma.[2] It was the first Tamil film to run for a year in a single theatre.  Chintamani was based on the legendary story of a Sanskrit poet and devotee of Lord Krishna named Bilwamangal (M. K. Thyragaraja Bhagavathar). Bilwamangal, a resident of Varanasi, was a Sanskrit scholar, who gets infatuated towards a courtesan called Chintamani (Aswathamma), a woman of ill-fame. As a result, he deserts his wife. However, Chintamani is an ardent devotee of Lord Krishna (Serugalathur Sama) and spends most of her time singing bhajans in praise of Lord Krishna. His attraction towards Chintamani eventually draws Bilwamangal closer towards Lord Krishna and transforms his life forever. Bilwangal, himself, becomes a devotee of Lord Krishna and pens a monumental Sanskrit work Sri Krishna Karnamritam.

Super Singer is a reality-based Indian singing competition in Tamil language that aired on STAR Vijay. The program seeks to discover the best singing talent in Tamil Nadu through a series of statewide auditions. The show is sponsored by the mobile service provider, Airtel. The show debuted in 2006 and has completed its three seasons,presently in fourth season. The winner of event gets a chance to sing a Tamil movie song.

The show usually airs on All Weekday nights in India and is telecast worldwide through partner broadcasting networks.

items.title: Suzhal - The Vortex
items.overview: A minor girl goes missing in a small town in Tamilnadu and an investigation follows. A sub inspector investigating a missing girl's case in a uncovers some shocking revelations and dirty truths those threaten to shake up the cultural societal fabric.

overviews.pt: Um thriller criminal que vai além da investigação de rotina e ameaça abalar o tecido social cultural quando um crime é cometido em uma pequena cidade na Índia. Passado como plano de fundo de um pequeno festival singular, antigos mitos colidem com o perturbador presente enquanto somos levados para o olho do furacão.
overviews.fr: Suzhal - Le Vortex est un thriller policier qui va au-delà de l'enquête de routine et menace de secouer le tissu socio-culturel d'une petite ville d'Inde lorsqu'un crime la frappe. Dans le cadre d'un micro-festival particulier, les mythes anciens se heurtent à un présent troublant qui nous entraine dans l'œil du cyclone.
overviews.es: Suzhal es un thriller que va más allá de una investigación rutinaria y que amenaza con poner patas arriba el entramado social, cuando se produce un crimen en un pequeño pueblo de la India. Ambientado en un microfestial único, antiguos mitos impactarán contra un turbulendo presente a medida que nos adentramos en el ojo de la tormenta.
overviews.it: Vortice è un thriller poliziesco che va oltre le indagini di routine e minaccia di sconvolgere il tessuto sociale culturale, quando un crimine colpisce una piccola città dell'India. Sullo sfondo di un micro-festival unico, i miti antichi si scontrano con il preoccupante presente mentre veniamo attirati nell'occhio del ciclone.
overviews.de: Suzhal - Im Strudel des Verbrechens ist ein Krimi, der über die Routineuntersuchung hinausgeht und droht, das kulturelle Gesellschaftsgefüge zu erschüttern, als ein Verbrechen eine kleine Stadt in Indien heimsucht. Vor dem Hintergrund eines einzigartigen Mikrofestivals kollidieren alte Mythen mit der beunruhigenden Gegenwart, während wir ins Auge des Sturms gezogen werden.
overviews.ko: 인도의 작은 마을에서 발생한 범죄 사건이 일상적인 수사를 넘어 문화적 사회 구조를 뒤흔든다. 독특한 지역 축제를 배경으로 한 고대 신화는 골치 아픈 현재와 충돌하고, 이야기는 폭풍의 눈으로 빠져든다.
overviews.pl: „Suzhal. Wir” to thriller kryminalny, który nie ogranicza się do przedstawienia rutynowego śledztwa. Pokazuje także skutki zbrodni, która grozi rozerwaniem tkanki społecznej pewnego indyjskiego miasteczka. Na tle niepowtarzalnego lokalnego festiwalu starożytne mity zderzają się z budzącą grozę teraźniejszością, a widzowie zostają wciągnięci w oko cyklonu.

He stops at nothing in his efforts to find the truth behind unexplainable murders while also battling various challenges in his personal life.

overviews.ko: 회의적인 리시 난단 경위는 듬직한 부하 아이나르와 치트라의 협조로 작은 산골 마을에서 일어난 기이한 연쇄 살인 사건을 수사한다. 사람들은 바나랏치라는 무시무시한 숲의 악령이 사람들을 죽였다고 믿는다.
overviews.tr: Şüpheci Suç Masası Müfettişi Rishi Nandhan, güvendiği müfettiş yardımcıları Ayyanar ve Chitra'nın yardımıyla ufak bir dağ köyünde, güya Vanaratchi adındaki ölümcül bir orman cini tarafından işlenmiş bir dizi tuhaf cinayeti soruşturuyor.
